name: Arrays & Hashing
description: Hash maps, sets, frequency counting, prefix sums, and bucket sort.

name: Two Pointers
description: Opposite ends, fast & slow pointers, two-sum on sorted arrays, partition.

name: Sliding Window
description: Fixed size, dynamic expansion & contraction, frequency map inside window.

name: Stack
description: LIFO, monotonic stack for next greater element, parenthesis matching.

name: Binary Search
description: Standard binary search, search on answer space, rotated sorted arrays.

name: Linked List
description: Pointer manipulation, fast & slow pointers, reversal, merge k-sorted.

name: Trees
description: DFS, BFS, BST properties, tree construction, path sums, LCA, serialization.

name: Tries
description: Prefix trees, wildcard search, multi-word matching on grid.

name: Heap / Priority Queue
description: Min/Max heaps, Top-K elements, streaming median, task scheduler.

name: Backtracking
description: Subsets, permutations, combinations, search with pruning, N-Queens.

name: Graphs
description: BFS, DFS, topological sort, Union-Find (disjoint set), cycle detection.

name: Advanced Graphs
description: Dijkstra's shortest path, Prim's/Kruskal's MST, Bellman-Ford, Eulerian path.

name: 1-D Dynamic Programming
description: Linear state transition, memoization, tabulation, house robber, coin change.

name: 2-D Dynamic Programming
description: Grid paths, LCS, edit distance, target sum, knapsack variants.

name: Greedy
description: Local optimal choice, jump game, gas station, partition labels.

name: Intervals
description: Overlapping intervals, merging, insertion, meeting rooms.

name: Math & Geometry
description: Matrix rotation, spiral traversal, modular arithmetic, fast exponentiation.

name: Bit Manipulation
description: Bitwise XOR, AND, OR, bit masks, count set bits, single number.
